why: The parenthetical is backwards. The expression the solution then writes, 15t - (1/2)g t^2, is the DISPLACEMENT of the stone, not the distance it has travelled: at the meeting time t = 2 s the stone has passed its highest point (t = 1.5 s, 11.25 m) and come back down to 10 m, so its path length is 11.25 + 1.25 = 12.5 m while its displacement is 10 m. Left as printed, the line teaches that 'distance' is computed by the displacement formula, which is the one thing this section exists to distinguish. The two words are swapped so the sentence matches the mathematics that follows; the meeting height (10 m) and time (2 s) are unaffected.
find: The distances (not displacements) travelled by the stone and the ball
replace: The displacements (not distances) of the stone and the ball
